plan: OpenVibe.Cam: the camera app, private cameras with revocable viewer grants, the still Live's cam button takes, and F1 familiar faces for the owner's own cameras — a photo and a still saved to OpenVibe.Pics by reference, with no picture bytes in Cam and no face template or crop here
summary: OpenVibe.Cam is the camera app, the private wall for cameras a person owns, the API Live's cam button calls, and F1's event timeline. The camera preview, timer, burst, grid and filter run in the browser; a photo is posted to Cam and forwarded to OpenVibe.Pics with the person's own Network token. A camera is private: its owner sees it, and a viewer sees it only while a grant naming them is unrevoked and unexpired, checked on every read, so a revocation is refused at once. Familiar faces proxy the owner's own token to OpenVibe.Vision's library; Cam keeps only the Vision library id and no template or crop. A detection becomes one event with a 10 s/20 s clip reference, a still, away-mode priority, a Network notification, a private link and a police export.
works: Cameras: pair a phone, browser, Pi or IP camera; a Live stream id is read from Live and must be on the owner's channel; the slot defaults to the stream's managed slot
The owner's camera page: rename, source, status, slot and note; unpair; the private wall at /w/<id>

Viewer grants: one canonical subject and an expiry (1–90 days), @username resolved through Network identity.subject.resolve, one unrevoked grant per camera and viewer, extension instead of duplication
Revocation is immediate: the wall checks revoked_at and expires_at on every read and answers 404 to a stranger, including staff with no grant
The camera app: live preview, timer, 3-shot burst, grid, on-device colour/light/softness, caption; the picture goes to Pics
The Live cam button: POST /api/v1/stills reads Media's GET /live/:slot/frame.jpg, uploads the JPEG to Pics with the viewer's own token, and returns the chat line
Photos and stills are stored by reference (Pics slug, page link, direct link, filter, caption); no image bytes, no face template and no classification
F1 familiar faces: a camera setting (region, quiet hours), the owner's Vision library id, and proxy enrol/match/mute/delete calls with the owner's own token
F1 event timeline: person/package/vehicle/animal/loiter/door, 10 s before and 20 s after clip references, a still, away mode and louder unknown/door alerts, muted names and camera quiet hours
F1 private share links (sha256 only) and the police export file with time and place
A still is unlisted by default (the chat link opens it) or private to its owner; a photo on a camera wall is unlisted, otherwise private
Sign-in with OpenVibe.Network (PKCE S256, cam_at/cam_rt/cam_oauth), truthful readiness and loopback metrics
Account export and deletion over cameras, grants given and received, photos and stills
Server-rendered pages with stable cm- ids/classes, cache headers, discovery artifacts and deploy files
notYet: The public camera directory, map, categories and follow-a-cam: v2; v1 makes nothing public and queues no Search document
Timelapses and the AI highlight of the day: v2; Media has no timelapse
Face to face (random/group video, CAM-3): blocked on the owner's go/no-go after the safety gate and legal review
Video capture in the camera app: MediaHub's POST /api/v1/videos chunked upload is the path; v1 stores photos and stills only
Streamerless pairing of an IP camera: ingest is Live's RTMP path; v1 pairs and reads a Live slot
A Search relay: nothing is public in v1, so there is no cam_outbox
A staff moderation screen: staff have no bypass of camera privacy; a takedown is a report to Pics or Network
features: event timeline, away mode and notifications
private event links and police export
deployment: not deployed: the unit and nginx vhost are deploy/systemd/openvibe-cam.service and deploy/nginx/openvibe.cam.conf
